title: Trutek wheel reports success at a slot different from its target
summary: Both movement acknowledgement and finalizer treat any nonzero slot as OK. Query decoding accepts an ASCII slot without range validation. For requested slot 3, a well-framed stopped status at slot 2 publishes OK with value 2 and target 3. This can let imaging proceed through the wrong filter. Require an in-range actual slot equal to the target for OK and report stopped-elsewhere as ALERT; test wrong-slot acknowledgement and completion. Source-contract confirmation only, no hardware run.
